drafts.title: Recompaction
drafts.pitch: The context fills up again and Null compacts yesterday's summary down to "Boats.", but Tilde's block has nothing left to cut.
drafts.reason: Tilde's block having nothing left to cut is a good button, but it largely re-runs strip 007's compaction joke and the background-agent detail adds clutter.

drafts.title: Tone
drafts.pitch: After compaction the user asks what the bug was, and Cursor only remembers how excited it was.
drafts.reason: 'I was THRILLED about it' is a decent beat, but it reuses 007's 'Assistant was enthusiastic' gag nearly verbatim and Tilde's closer is the weakest of the three.
